original_test_intent: Verify that each installed PSU's local indicator uniquely represents five specified electrical/operating conditions through the correct off, solid-amber, solid-green, blinking-green and blinking-amber patterns while the platform remains within its approved redundancy and load envelope.
original_method: Select the unique row; identify SUT, PSU bay, PN/serial/firmware, AC feed and redundancy/load topology; obtain the authoritative LED cadence table and safe method for each condition; baseline all LEDs, power telemetry and preserved events; a qualified operator establishes one approved state at a time on the named PSU, records synchronized video long enough to distinguish solid from blink, captures BMC/PSU state corroboration, restores the baseline before the next state, and stops on unexpected shutdown, overload or electrical anomaly; finally restore full redundancy.
manual_activity: A qualified hardware operator establishes every approved power condition, directly observes and records LED color/cadence, monitors electrical safety and restores redundancy; the agent only organizes supplied evidence.
required_inputs: SUT PSU bay-to-PN/serial/firmware and AC feed/outlet map
Measured load and redundancy capacity for each manipulated state
Vendor-approved safe procedure for off/unplugged, injected/real fault, normal, standby and cord-absent/backfed conditions
Authoritative color and blink cadence/duty-cycle oracle plus observation duration
Abort limits, final full-redundancy state and BMC/physical recovery plan
safety_requirements: Calculate survivor capacity and obtain approval before removing any feed or PSU contribution
Use qualified electrical handling; never create a fault by unsafe shorting, obstruction or connector abuse
Name the exact bay, feed and condition before every action and confirm restoration afterward
Preserve SEL/host logs and power telemetry without clearing prior evidence
Stop on overload, arc/odor/heat, wrong PSU, unexpected shutdown, fan/power anomaly or ambiguous LED; do not repeat automatically
agent_execution_scope: Validate identity, state matrix, load/redundancy calculation and operator approval
Organize timestamped video, power telemetry and BMC/SEL corroboration supplied by the operator
Compare observed state labels to the approved table without claiming sight
Do not unplug cords, induce PSU faults, manipulate power, infer LED remotely, clear logs, retry or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve population/feed map, load envelope and safe stimulus for every state
Approve exact blink frequency/duty cycle and whether backfeed is a supported PSU behavior
Review visual/electrical evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a per-bay electrical-state matrix with synchronized video and independent PSU input/output/BMC telemetry, restoring full redundancy after each hazardous condition.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact identity, load/redundancy proof, safe state stimuli, cadence measurement, aborts and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: BMC presence, PSU status bits or still photos cannot alone prove color and blink cadence tied to each physical condition.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Fault and no-cord/backfeed conditions may be platform- or PSU-specific; removing a feed under insufficient redundancy can power off or damage the SUT.

project_override_considerations: Engineering must define whether fault is induced with a vendor fixture/command or observed from an approved faulty module and distinguish standby from normal low load. If a state is unsupported, it must be recorded as a scoped decision rather than improvised.

Per-state video long enough to prove off/solid/blink color and cadence on the exact bay
Synchronized PSU input/output/current/power plus BMC/SEL/host corroboration
Restoration to full redundancy, anomaly/recovery record and engineer verdict

review_improvement: Turns a generic visual lookup into a safe per-PSU electrical-state experiment with traceable color/cadence evidence and mandatory redundancy restoration.
independent_technical_reasoning: The LED encodes local PSU electrical state, so software telemetry cannot replace direct observation and physical feed topology. Solid versus blinking requires time-based video, not a still image. The cord-absent/backfed case is especially topology-dependent: auxiliary energy from a redundant bus can produce a vendor-specific warning state, and an unsafe attempt to create it can remove the SUT's remaining capacity. A fault must be induced only by an approved mechanism, never improvised. These irreducibly physical observations make the entire case MANUAL ONLY even though logs may corroborate it.
